node.statement: Let M be an arbitrary compact smooth manifold without boundary. Smooth means C-infinity, hence M is a C^r manifold for every finite r, and the sourced terminology in the registry shard identifies without boundary with the non-bounded case. Therefore GT-munkres-edt-thm-10.6 applies and supplies a simplicial complex K together with a C^r triangulation f: |K| -> M.
